searchText: Can someone explain to me what: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/master/EIPS/eip-1559.md#backwards-compatibility What is this trying to say? Is it that the fees will be higher for the user submitting the transactions? Not exactly: it means they don’t get a refund based on the difference between FEE CAP and the TIP+BASE FEE So they can’t set a high fee cap as a buffer: if their gas price is too high, the extra goes to the miner vs txn sender
